descriptors.name: relativeVolume
descriptors.definition: Ratio of solid material volume to total bounding box volume

descriptors.name: relativeArea
descriptors.definition: Specific surface area: total solid surface area divided by reference volume

descriptors.name: thickness
descriptors.definition: Median local material thickness: compute Euclidean distance field of the void phase, index it at solid-phase skeleton voxels, take the median, and double it
descriptors.formula: D = bwdist(~solid); skel = bwskel(solid); thickness = 2 * median(D(skel)) * voxel_size_mm

descriptors.name: poreDiameter
descriptors.definition: Diameter of the largest inscribed sphere in the largest connected void component: compute Euclidean distance field from solid voxels, restrict to the largest 26-connected void component, and take twice the maximum distance. Returns NaN if no void exists.
descriptors.formula: voidMask = ~solid; D = bwdist(~voidMask); cc = bwconncomp(voidMask, 26); if cc.NumObjects == 0, poreDiameter = NaN; else, counts = cellfun(@numel, cc.PixelIdxList); [~, largestIdx] = max(counts); largestVoid = cc.PixelIdxList{largestIdx}; poreDiameter = 2 * max(D(largestVoid)) * voxel_size_mm; end

algorithm_params.step_4_empty_check: if cc.NumObjects == 0, poreDiameter = NaN; return; end
algorithm_params.step_5_largest_component: counts = cellfun(@numel, cc.PixelIdxList); [~, largestIdx] = max(counts); largestVoid = cc.PixelIdxList{largestIdx}

descriptors.name: areaMean
descriptors.definition: Mean of the largest connected pore cross-sectional area at 26 uniformly spaced z-slices along the gradient axis, computed in physical coordinates with 8-connectivity, excluding empty slices, and reported in mm^2
descriptors.formula: sliceIndices = round(linspace(1, Nz, 26)); areas = []; for i = 1:26, sl = ~solid(:,:,sliceIndices(i)); cc2 = bwconncomp(sl, 8); if cc2.NumObjects > 0, counts = cellfun(@numel, cc2.PixelIdxList); areas(end+1) = max(counts) * voxel_size_mm^2; end; end; areaMean = mean(areas)

algorithm_params.coordinate_system: voxel index mapped to physical z via z_phys = (sliceIndex - 1) * voxel_size_mm
algorithm_params.empty_slice_handling: excluded from mean (skipped, not counted as zero)

changes: poreDiameter: bwdist(~voidMask) with MATLAB-compatible max(counts) instead of argmax
poreDiameter: explicit cc.NumObjects==0 handling returns NaN
thickness: distance field indexed at skeleton voxels, median statistic
areaMean: frozen with 26 uniform slices including endpoints, 8-connectivity, empty slices excluded, pixel_count*voxel_size_mm^2 normalization
All formulas expressed as executable MATLAB code
